worldcombat.skill.cosmicpower.summary: Stands and takes a falling column of starlight: Defense and Special Defense both rise. The longest telegraph in its group and the easiest to interrupt, paid back at night when the stars are stronger — the same move raises one extra stage. Both stages are taken back when the window ends.
worldcombat.skill.cosmicpower.use.0: Open range, stand still and pull both defenses up at once
worldcombat.skill.cosmicpower.use.1: At night the stars are stronger and raise one extra stage
worldcombat.skill.cosmicpower.use.2: Thicken the shell before a beating, then turn back into the fight
worldcombat.skill.cosmicpower.descriptio: Cosmic Power raises Defense by %1$s stages and Special Defense by %2$s; at night (sunlight below a quarter) each rises one more.
The starlight lasts about %1$s; when it fades or is removed, both of those Defense and Special Defense stages are taken back.
worldcombat.skill.cosmicpower.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.cosmicpower.growth.0: At level %1$s the starlight lasts %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.cosmicpower.growth.1: At level %1$s the starlight reaches %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.cosmicpower.preference: Consider standing for starlight when a threat is within this distance; larger starts earlier.
A threat closer than this makes the companion fight instead of gathering; larger gives up setup more often up close.
Below this health ratio the companion gathers before the shared order; larger enters the defensive stance sooner, smaller only when nearly down.
worldcombat.skill.cosmicpower.descriptio: The user stands still while casting and the telegraph is long; being interrupted before the starlight lands grants nothing.
